brief: Reduce visible copy and competing controls across the native app
subject: Hands-on visual tutorials; choose a task, then watch the object move

type.titles: Native Dynamic Type large title, medium/semibold
type.body: Native system body for catalog names, system type for controls
type.utility: System monospaced digits for step count

layout.home: Object-first catalog, one-line names, native category control; no section paragraphs or hero marketing

layout.AR: Back, step count, one placement prompt while needed; secondary options in a menu
layout.everyday: Visual movement, slider and icon controls; materials/checkpoint/long instruction in disclosures; confirmation remains explicit

signature: The teaching object occupies the screen; controls form one quiet tray below it
